column1: # Formal mutation checks (SPEC 15.6, Appendix A.9). Read by
#   id           Case name. Also the prefix of its evidence files.
#   patches      Space-separated patches from formal/mutations/, applied in
#                order to a copy of formal/MarginReview.tla. "-" applies none
#                and checks the unmutated base model.
#   config       TLC configuration (file name in formal/) for the run.
#   expect       pass, or violated:<property> for the designated detector
#   trace_action TLC names the action that produced the final counterexample
#                state. The runner validates it against the dumped JSON
#                trace. "-" skips the check for passing cases.
# The two control rows re-run the matched cooperative/uncooperative writer
# pair from SPEC 15.6 next to mutation 08, so one summary table shows that
# the base model passes where the mutant fails.
